title: 意识
sub: 我们对自己与外界的主观体验——能「觉察到正在发生什么」的那部分心智。
subEn: Our subjective awareness of self and world — the part of the mind that knows something is happening.

title: 记忆
sub: 把信息编码、储存、并在需要时为所用的能力。
subEn: The ability to encode, store, and retrieve information when needed.

title: 情绪
sub: 由生理唤醒、主观感受和行为倾向共同组成的复杂状态，如喜、怒、恐、悲。
subEn: A complex state of physiological arousal, subjective feeling and action tendency — joy, anger, fear, sadness.

title: 动机
sub: 推动我们发起、维持并指向某目标的内部动力。
subEn: The internal drive that initiates, sustains and directs behavior toward a goal.

title: 人格
sub: 相对稳定、跨情境的思维、情绪与行为模式的总和。
subEn: The relatively stable, cross-situational patterns of thinking, feeling and behaving.

title: 依恋
sub: 婴儿与主要照料者之间形成的持久情感联结，影响一生的人际关系。
subEn: The enduring emotional bond between infant and primary caregiver that shapes relationships for life.

title: 归因
sub: 我们如何解释自己与他人的行为原因——是性格使然，还是情境所迫。
subEn: How we explain the causes of behavior — disposition or situation.

title: 自我
sub: 个体对「我是谁」的认知与感受，包括自我概念、自尊与自我监控。
subEn: One's sense of 'who I am' — self-concept, self-esteem and self-monitoring.

title: 自我效能
sub: 你相信自己「能做到某件事」的程度，比能力本身更影响行动。
subEn: How strongly you believe 'I can do this' — it shapes action more than ability alone.

title: 大五人格
sub: 用五个维度描述人格：开放、尽责、外向、宜人、神经质。
subEn: Personality in five traits: Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness, Neuroticism.

title: 条件反射
sub: 巴甫洛夫的狗听到铃声就流口水，就是「条件」被「反射」出来的典型。
subEn: Pavlov's dog salivating at a bell is the classic case of a conditioned reflex.

title: 图式
sub: 你脑子里有一张「餐厅该怎么点餐」的默认模板，这就是图式；去到陌生餐厅就靠它快速应对。
subEn: You carry a default 'how to order at a restaurant' template in your head — that's a schema guiding new situations.

title: 心理防御机制
sub: 把不敢面对的欲望包装成「我根本不在乎」，就是一种防御——保护自己不被痛苦击垮。
subEn: Reframing an unbearable desire as 'I don't care anyway' is a defense that shields you from pain.

title: 认知失调
sub: 明知道吸烟有害却还在抽，心里别扭——为了不别扭，你可能暗暗说服自己「危害被夸大了」。
subEn: Knowing smoking harms yet still smoking feels off — to ease it you may quietly tell yourself 'the risk is exaggerated'.

title: 启动效应
sub: 先看到「医生」这个词，再填「__生」时你更可能写「医生」而非「学生」——隐性的联想被点亮了。
subEn: After seeing 'doctor', you're more likely to complete '__or' as 'doctor' — a hidden association lit up.

title: 强化
sub: 孩子收拾好玩具就给贴纸（正强化），或写完作业就不必洗碗（负强化），都是在「加料」让好行为更常出现。
subEn: A sticker for tidying (positive) or skipping dishes after homework (negative) both 'add incentive' for good behavior.

title: 习得性无助
sub: 笼中狗被反复电击却逃不掉，后来门开着也不敢逃——它「学会」了无助。人长期受挫也可能如此。
subEn: A caged dog shocked with no escape later won't flee even with the door open — it 'learned' helplessness. Humans under chronic failure do too.

title: 心理理论
sub: 你知道「妈妈看不见盒子里的糖，所以她不知道糖在哪」——这种「别人想法和我不同」的洞察就是心理理论。
subEn: Realizing 'mom can't see the candy, so she doesn't know where it is' — that insight that others' minds differ is theory of mind.

title: 西格蒙德·弗洛伊德
sub: 提出潜意识与心理结构（本我/自我/超我），开创谈话疗法，深刻影响了对「非理性自我」的理解。
subEn: Proposed the unconscious and the id/ego/superego structure, founded the talking cure, and reshaped how we see the irrational self.

title: 让·皮亚杰
sub: 用「图式—同化—顺应」解释儿童如何主动建构对世界的理解，提出认知发展的四个阶段。
subEn: Explained how children actively build understanding via schema-assimilation-accommodation, proposing four stages of cognitive development.

title: 伯尔赫斯·斯金纳
sub: 用操作性条件反射与强化程式解释行为，主张「环境塑造行为」，对程序教学与行为矫正影响深远。
subEn: Explained behavior via operant conditioning and reinforcement schedules, arguing 'environment shapes behavior', influencing programmed instruction and behavior modification.

title: 阿尔伯特·班杜拉
sub: 提出观察学习与自我效能，证明人不仅被强化塑造，也通过「看别人怎么做」和「相信自己能行」来改变。
subEn: Proposed observational learning and self-efficacy, showing people are shaped not only by reinforcement but by watching others and believing in their own capability.

title: 丹尼尔·卡尼曼
sub: 用「系统1/系统2」解释人类如何在直觉与理性间切换，揭示了一系列稳定的判断偏差。
subEn: Explained how humans switch between intuition and reason via System 1 / System 2, revealing a family of stable judgment biases.

title: 亚伯拉罕·马斯洛
sub: 用「需求层次金字塔」说明人先求生存安全，再追求归属、尊重与自我实现。
subEn: Used the 'hierarchy of needs' pyramid to show people seek safety first, then belonging, esteem and self-actualization.

title: 伊万·巴甫洛夫
sub: 用狗的唾液分泌实验发现经典条件反射，证明「联想」可以重塑生理反应。
subEn: With dogs' salivation, discovered classical conditioning — that association can reshape physiological response.

title: 保罗·艾克曼
sub: 通过跨文化研究论证基本情绪及其面部表情具有普遍性，并开发了微表情判别工具。
subEn: Argued basic emotions and their facial expressions are universal across cultures, and built tools to read micro-expressions.

title: 精神分析
sub: 以潜意识、童年冲突与驱力为核心，用谈话疗法探查行为背后的深层动力。
subEn: Centers on the unconscious, childhood conflict and drives, using the talking cure to probe deep motives.

title: 行为主义
sub: 只研究可观察的刺激—反应，用学习律解释一切行为，拒斥内在心理实体。
subEn: Studies only observable stimulus-response, explaining all behavior by learning laws, rejecting inner mental entities.

title: 认知心理学
sub: 把心智当作信息加工系统，研究注意、记忆、语言与问题解决的内部机制。
subEn: Treats the mind as an information-processing system, studying attention, memory, language and problem solving.

title: 人本心理学
sub: 强调人的主动性、潜能与尊严，关注成长、自我实现与治疗中的真诚关系。
subEn: Stresses human agency, potential and dignity, focusing on growth, self-actualization and the genuine therapeutic bond.

title: 进化心理学
sub: 用自然选择解释心智机制的起源，认为许多倾向是祖先环境中适应问题的产物。
subEn: Explains the origin of mental mechanisms via natural selection, seeing many tendencies as products of ancestral adaptive problems.

title: 神经心理学
sub: 用脑科学与神经影像把心智过程定位到具体的脑区与环路。
subEn: Locates mental processes in specific brain regions and circuits via neuroscience and neuroimaging.

title: 积极心理学
sub: 不只研究病态，也系统研究幸福、优势、韧性与意义等「如何让人生更好」的议题。
subEn: Not only pathology, but systematically studies happiness, strengths, resilience and meaning — 'what makes life worth living'.

title: 构造主义
sub: 用「内省」把意识拆成基本元素，试图像化学元素表那样画一张心智地图。
subEn: Used introspection to break consciousness into basic elements, aiming for a 'periodic table' of the mind.

title: 确认偏误
sub: 我们更愿相信支持已有观点的证据，忽略反面信息。
subEn: We favor evidence that supports what we already believe and dismiss the rest.

title: 锚定效应
sub: 先看到的数字会拽住后续判断，哪怕它毫无关系。
subEn: The first number we see drags later judgments, even if irrelevant.

title: 可得性偏差
sub: 容易想起的事，就被当成更常见的事。
subEn: What comes easily to mind feels more common.

title: 损失厌恶
sub: 亏 100 块的痛，约是赚 100 块的快的两倍。
subEn: The pain of losing 100 feels about twice the joy of gaining 100.

title: 从众效应
sub: 越多人相信，越容易跟着信——哪怕人人都错。
subEn: The more people believe something, the likelier we follow—even if all are wrong.

title: 沉没成本
sub: 已经花掉、收不回的，不该影响接下来的决定。
subEn: Money or time already spent and unrecoverable shouldn't shape future choices.

title: 光环效应
sub: 一个人某方面出色，我们就以为他样样都行。
subEn: If someone excels at one thing, we assume they're good at everything.

title: 邓宁-克鲁格效应
sub: 越不懂，越容易高估自己；越精通，越知不足。
subEn: The least skilled overestimate most; the most skilled underestimate.

title: 斯坦福监狱实验
sub: 普通大学生随机扮狱警/囚犯，几天就「入戏」到失控。
subEn: Ordinary students assigned as guards or prisoners 'became' their roles within days.

title: 米尔格拉姆服从实验
sub: 被试在「权威」指令下，愿对陌生人施加致命电击（假的）。
subEn: Under 'authority', participants delivered (fake) lethal shocks to a stranger.

title: 棉花糖实验
sub: 能忍住不吃眼前棉花糖的孩子，日后表现更好？
subEn: Kids who delayed a marshmallow seemed to do better later—maybe.

title: 小阿尔伯特实验
sub: 用巨响让婴儿对毛茸茸的东西产生恐惧，证明恐惧可习得。
subEn: A baby was conditioned to fear furry things with a loud noise—fear can be learned.

title: 阿希从众实验
sub: 明明看见线更长，却跟着群体选了错的。
subEn: People picked the wrong line just to match the group.

title: 巴甫洛夫的狗
sub: 铃声一响狗就流口水——无关刺激也能触发反应。
subEn: A bell alone made dogs salivate—neutral cues can trigger responses.

title: 认知失调实验
sub: 为无聊任务拿钱少的人，反而更觉得任务有趣。
subEn: Those paid little for a boring task found it more interesting.

title: 冯特建立第一个心理学实验室
titleEn: Wundt founds the first psychology lab
sub: 心理学从哲学里独立出来，成为用实验研究心智的学科。
subEn: Psychology split from philosophy into an experimental science of the mind.

title: 弗洛伊德《梦的解析》
sub: 把无意识推上舞台，开创精神分析。
subEn: Put the unconscious on stage; founded psychoanalysis.

title: 华生提出行为主义
sub: 「只研究可观察的行为」，把内省赶出科学。
subEn: 'Study only observable behavior'—banned introspection from science.

title: 皮亚杰的儿童认知发展
sub: 孩子的思维不是「小号成人」，而是分阶段建构的。
subEn: Children don't think like small adults; they build thought in stages.

title: 斯金纳的操作性条件反射
sub: 奖励与惩罚塑造行为，强化 schedule 决定快慢。
subEn: Rewards and punishments shape behavior; schedules set the pace.

title: 马斯洛需求层次
sub: 从吃饱穿暖到自我实现，需求像阶梯。
subEn: From safety to self-actualization, needs climb like a ladder.

title: 认知革命
sub: 心智被重新当作「信息处理器」，黑箱被打开。
subEn: Mind re-read as an information processor; the black box opened.

title: 班杜拉社会学习（波波娃实验）
sub: 孩子看大人打娃娃，自己也会学样——观察也能学习。
subEn: Kids who saw adults hit a doll copied it—learning by watching.

title: 卡尼曼与前景理论
sub: 人不是理性计算器，决策充满系统性偏差。
subEn: People aren't rational calculators; decisions are systematically biased.

title: 脑成像时代
sub: fMRI 让「心智活动」第一次被看见。
subEn: fMRI let 'mental activity' be seen for the first time.

title: 积极心理学兴起
sub: 不只治「病」，也研究「怎样活得更好」。
subEn: Not just treating illness, but studying 'how to live well'.

title: AI 与心理学的相遇
sub: 大模型既成研究对象，也成辅助工具与伦理新题。
subEn: LLMs are both a research subject and a tool—with fresh ethics questions.

title: 拖延
sub: 不是懒，是「现在的情绪」压过了「未来的自己」。
subEn: Not laziness—present feelings override the future self.

title: 决策疲劳
sub: 一天做太多选择，后面就越随便或越冲动。
subEn: Too many choices in a day makes later ones careless or impulsive.

title: 社交媒体与情绪
sub: 刷得越久越空：比较和算法在悄悄消耗你。
subEn: More scrolling, more hollow: comparison and algorithms drain you.

title: 亲密关系与依恋
sub: 亲密里的反应，常是童年依恋模式的重演。
subEn: How we react in love often replays childhood attachment.

title: 职业倦怠
sub: 不是累了睡一觉就好，是长期失控与耗竭。
subEn: Not fixed by sleep—chronic depletion from loss of control.

title: 育儿中的夸奖
sub: 夸「努力」比夸「聪明」更能扛挫折。
subEn: Praising effort beats praising smarts for resilience.

title: 睡眠与记忆
sub: 睡好觉，大脑才把白天的信息「归档」。
subEn: In sleep, the brain files away the day's information.

title: 「左脑人 / 右脑人」
sub: 没有谁只用半边脑；分工是粗略的，整体协作才是常态。
subEn: No one uses just one hemisphere;分工 is rough and whole-brain by default.

title: 「血型决定性格」
sub: 血型与性格无关，这是流行文化而非科学。
subEn: Blood type and personality are unrelated—pop culture, not science.

title: 「多元智能测试能测出你擅长什么」
sub: 加德纳的「多元智能」是框架，不是可精测的能力量表。
subEn: Gardner's 'multiple intelligences' is a framework, not a precise test.

title: 「人只用了 10% 的大脑」
titleEn: We Only Use 10% of Our Brain
sub: 全脑几乎时刻都在耗氧工作，10% 纯属都市传说。
subEn: The whole brain burns oxygen nearly all the time; 10% is a myth.

title: 「记忆像录像带」
sub: 记忆每次回想都被重写，会掺入后来信息。
subEn: Each recall rewrites memory, mixing in later information.

title: 「男女用脑方式完全不同，要分开教」
sub: 两性大脑差异远小于个体间差异，分性别教学缺乏依据。
subEn: Sex differences in brain are far smaller than person-to-person ones; segregated teaching lacks basis.

title: 读新闻只挑认同的媒体，这在心理学叫？
titleEn: Only reading like-minded news is called what?
sub: 一种常见但会窄化视野的认知习惯。
subEn: A common habit that narrows your view.

title: 约 2/3 被试在「权威」指令下愿意对陌生人施加致命电击，出自哪个实验？
titleEn: Which experiment had ~2/3 obey 'authority' to 'lethal' shocks?
sub: 一个关于服从的经典社会实验。
subEn: A classic social study of obedience.

title: 「人只用了 10% 的大脑」这个说法？
titleEn: The claim 'we only use 10% of our brain' is...
sub: 一条流传很广的说法。
subEn: A widely spread claim.

title: 亏 100 块的痛，约是赚 100 块的快的多少倍？
titleEn: The pain of losing 100 feels about how many times the joy of gaining 100?
sub: 一个关于风险偏好的核心发现。
subEn: A core finding about risk preference.

title: 哪种夸法更有助于孩子扛挫折？
titleEn: Which praise better builds resilience in kids?
sub: 育儿中一个被反复验证的差别。
subEn: A repeatedly tested difference in parenting.

title: 东亚文化更常见的「自我」倾向是？
titleEn: East Asian cultures lean toward which 'self'?
sub: 跨文化心理学的一个经典区分。
subEn: A classic cross-cultural distinction.

title: 自我建构：独立 vs 互依
sub: 西方更把「我」当独立个体，东亚更把「我」放在关系里。
subEn: The West leans independent self; East Asia leans interdependent self.

title: 个体主义 vs 集体主义
sub: 一端重个人权利，一端重群体归属，两端都在光谱上。
subEn: One end prizes individual rights, the other group belonging—both lie on a spectrum.

title: 情绪表达：外显 vs 内敛
sub: 西方更鼓励说出感受，东亚更讲「看场合、给面子」。
subEn: The West encourages saying feelings; East Asia weighs occasion and 'face'.

title: 育儿：自主探索 vs 管教成材
sub: 西方偏「让孩子自己选」，东亚偏「为长远铺路、重规矩」。
subEn: The West leans 'let them choose'; East Asia leans 'pave the long road, value discipline'.

title: 从众：个性 vs 合群
sub: 西方为「不跟风」骄傲，东亚为「不失礼」克制。
subEn: The West prizes 'not following'; East Asia restrains to 'not offend'.

title: 心理求助：直面 vs 隐忍
sub: 西方更把求助当自我管理，东亚更怕「家丑外扬」。
subEn: The West treats help-seeking as self-care; East Asia fears 'airing dirty laundry'.
